symbolic_certificate.four_real_observables: V=Re(v_0 dot G)=X_B, Q=Re(q_0 dot G)=X_(B,x), A=Re(a_0 dot G)=A_B, and N=Re(n_0 dot G)=A_(B,x).
symbolic_certificate.real_quadratic_form: For g=(Re G_0,...,Re G_4,Im G_0,...,Im G_4)^T and R(z)=(Re z_0,...,Re z_4,-Im z_0,...,-Im z_4)^T, put v=R(v_0), q=R(q_0), a=R(a_0), n=R(n_0). Then h^2*Phi_B=g^T M g+ell_T^T g, M=(v n^T+n v^T-a q^T-q a^T)/2 and ell_T=X_T n+A_(T,x)v-A_T q-X_(T,x)a.
symbolic_certificate.rank_factorization: M=[v n a q] J [v n a q]^T with J=(1/2)*diag_offdiag(+1,-1); hence rank(M)<=4. The observation map g->(V,Q,A,N) has a real kernel of dimension at least 6, and Phi_B vanishes on that kernel.
symbolic_certificate.generic_inertia_guard: An exact algebraic specialization L=2,rho_1=rho_2=rho_(1,x)=rho_(2,x)=0,s_*'=-i/2,s_*''=0,chi_N=1,u_N=u_(N,x)=1 has observation rank 4 and minor 5/16. By the displayed congruence its M has inertia (2,2,6). This is a generic nonpromotion guard, not a physical Xi state.
symbolic_certificate.total_value_fibre: On X_T+V=0, h^2*Phi_B=V*A_(T,x)-(A_T+A)Q-A*X_(T,x), with no division by the total value.
symbolic_certificate.double_contact_obstruction: If also A_T+A=0, then Phi_B=-P_T>1/400. Therefore the desired bound must source-specifically exclude a simultaneous retained value/centered-scalar contact; it cannot assume it away.
